crypto_headlines.title: Strategy buys 485 more Bitcoin
crypto_headlines.summary: Strategy bought 485 BTC for $33.4 million at an average of $68,887 between Nov 9 and 15, bringing its total to 850,849 BTC.

crypto_headlines.title: Spot crypto ETFs bleed for another week
crypto_headlines.summary: BTC spot ETFs saw $1.07B in net outflows last week, with ETH at -$398.85M, SOL at -$32.05M and XRP at -$19.13M.

crypto_headlines.title: Solana drops the "mainnet beta" label
crypto_headlines.summary: Solana officially retired "mainnet beta" and introduced Solana 1.0, without changing the network.

crypto_headlines.title: MoneyGram partners with Solflare at Breakpoint
crypto_headlines.summary: Announced at Solana Breakpoint in London: Solflare wallet users will be able to cash out across 170 countries through MoneyGram.

crypto_headlines.title: Luxor to repay clients after hashrate hijack
crypto_headlines.summary: Luxor says an AI-enabled attack on its Commander tool redirected bitcoin rigs from over a dozen client accounts to the OCEAN pool, and it will repay affected clients in full.

crypto_headlines.title: CZ says Binance didn't sell the dump
crypto_headlines.summary: CZ said Binance didn't sell and that he bought crypto in recent days, listing ETF outflows, hacks, hot inflation and the midterms among possible reasons for the drop.

doginal_news.title: 21 days until DDMIAMI
doginal_news.summary: The countdown is on: three weeks left until DDMIAMI.

doginal_news.title: An unopened V1 Box of Awesomeness comes off eBay
doginal_news.summary: emeta777 is delisting their Doginal Dogs items on eBay, including one of the last unopened V1 Box of Awesomeness.

doginal_news.title: Hofer wins Legends Brackets Sunday
doginal_news.summary: Hofer beat nosheks 2-0 in the Bo3 final to take the Doginal Dogs Legends Brackets Sunday title.

doginal_news.title: Victorious Gary locked in for the Championship
doginal_news.summary: PawsMeta secured a Victorious Gary for the first DDLTCG Championship, with DDMiami less than four weeks away.

doginal_news.title: Douro Labs urges CFTC to require multi-source prices
doginal_news.summary: Douro Labs, a core Pyth contributor, told the CFTC that exchanges should use multi-source prices for margin and liquidations.

doginal_news.title: PIRB's Breakpoint charter jet contest
doginal_news.summary: PIRB imagined a Pyth charter flight to Solana Breakpoint and is giving spins to the three funniest names for the jet.
